description: Constructs a categorical mass formula for the Higgs (T(2,8)) using substrate quantities: P_4/P_2 (binomial pattern from PR #1125), 6/5 (cardinality ratio), and 1 - h_0^4 · 2G (h^4 correction from this branch's probe). Tests whether m_H = m_W · (P_4/P_2) · (6/5) · (1 - h_0^4 · 2G) matches the measured Higgs mass.
interpretation: If m_H prediction matches measurement within 1%, the formula has all categorical components: P_m from binomial pattern, 6/5 from cardinality ratio, 1 - h_0^4·2G from h^4 correction with Vol(B_3) anchor. This would be the FIRST constructed categorical mass formula for a torus-knot particle (Higgs) in the RT-route chain, using m_W as the anchor.
